title.zh: 既然 Character.AI 正在破产，其所有用户的数据将何去何从？
title.en: Now that Character.AI is going bankrupt, what happens to all of its users’ data?

current_state.zh:
纽约州总检察长 Letitia James 披露了一项针对 Character.AI 的、持续数年的多州联合调查，并与 40 位跨党派州总检察长共同在该公司的破产案中提交了「利害关系通知」（notice of interest）。该申请旨在要求对可能通过破产程序被出售的消费者数据施加保护措施。

40 位跨党派州总检察长的联合行动，使一家大型消费级 AI 平台的用户数据出售进入监管视野，表明各州当局有意在破产程序中对此类数据的转移方式施加影响。

据来源报道，该利害关系通知意在「让所有相关方注意到」所涉的监管问题；这属于一份通知性文件，而非法院裁决，也不构成对任何出售条款的批准。
current_state.en: New York Attorney General Letitia James revealed a multi-state investigation into Character.AI and, with 40 bipartisan state AGs, filed a notice of interest in its bankruptcy case seeking to impose protections on consumer data sold through the proceeding.

updates.background_zh: Character.ai 是一项生成式 AI 聊天机器人服务，用户可与可自定义的角色对话；该公司由前 Google 工程师 Noam Shazeer 和 Daniel De Freitas 于 2021 年 11 月创立。根据法律行业对其近期会议的报道，各州总检察长在 AI、隐私及儿童数据执法方面日趋活跃。
updates.background_en: Character.ai is a generative AI chatbot service where users converse with customizable characters; it was founded in November 2021 by Noam Shazeer and Daniel De Freitas, former Google engineers. State attorneys general have been increasingly active in AI, privacy and children's data enforcement, according to legal-industry coverage of their recent meetings.
